title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct expressions for the reduced density matrices in both position and momentum spaces and the diagonal elements of the position density matrix.

title: Density Operator Definition
description: Important Criteria: Clearly define the density operator and its role in calculating expectation values.

title: Orthogonal States
description: Important Criteria: Identify the orthogonal complete sets of states used in position and momentum spaces.

title: Mathematical Derivation
description: Important Criteria: Show the steps in deriving the relationship between the reduced density matrices and the diagonal elements.

title: Use of Delta Function
description: Optional Criteria: Explain the significance of the delta function in the context of the momentum density matrix.

title: Summation Over States
description: Optional Criteria: Discuss the implications of summing over momentum states in the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for mistakes in the application of the delta function or incorrect summation limits.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that units are consistent throughout the derivation and final expressions.
